Method of Attack: EngineerMode app can be used to root OnePlus devices by running a specific adb shell command with a code and password, effectively converting the app into a backdoor. OpDeviceManager is responsible for telemetry collection and performs intrusive operations on the device.
Impacted Systems: Some Motorola, Xiaomi, and Lenovo phones
Attack Vector: Physical access to the device to run adb shell commands
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of EngineerMode app accessible via *#808# SSID code
Command: adb shell am start -n com.android.engineeringmode/.qualcomm.DiagEnabled --es "CODE" "PASSWORD" where CODE=code and PASSWORD=angela
